purpose: Prevent future A/B scarcity modeling from treating dependent, OR-composite, two-sided and provenance-conditioned margins as interchangeable independent dimensions.

volume.policy: Preserve both branches and which branch passes; no average.

structure.policy: When supportMode=FILTERED_CANDIDATE, close>=0.985*support is structurally guaranteed by support eligibility and is not independent. On MA20_FALLBACK it may bind. todayLow-priorLow20 remains distinct.

notLate.policy: Keep both raw axes; lateStage is their OR fail-state.

trend.policy: Record which OR branch establishes trend; no single distance.

candleCloseGeometry.proof: upperShadowRatio<=1-dailyClosePosition, so strongClose pass implies upperShadow pass under coherent OHLC.
candleCloseGeometry.policy: Preserve both Formal booleans for provenance, but do not count them as independent research-distance dimensions.

notLate.policy: ret20<=30 dominates the ret20>35 lateStage arm; retain ret20<=30 and maDistance<=25 as the effective raw axes.

modelingGuardrails: No fitted weights before prospective CLEAN population coverage.
No single normalized distance until scale choice is preregistered and redundancy is tested.
Exact Formal bitmasks remain immutable provenance even where dimensions are dependent.
Unknown/missing source state never receives a zero margin.
Outcome models must cluster by scan date and control regime/sector/liquidity/ATR before any threshold discussion.
